summary: Phase 1 auth testing for OnlyBase. 12 backend API test cases covering register/login/me/logout/refresh/nonce/google(invalid)/farcaster(invalid)/farcaster-link(auth required)/duplicate-email/wrong-password/brute-force-lockout. 11/12 backend tests PASS. One real backend bug found: brute-force lockout fails behind kubernetes ingress because request.client.host is the proxy pod IP (rotating between 10.64.129.166 and 10.64.130.9) so the 5-attempt threshold never triggers on a single key. Frontend: all 3 auth methods render on /login, email register flow redirects to /feed, ProfilePage shows user name/handle/email auth chip, logout clears cookies, all 7 protected routes correctly redirect to /login when unauthenticated. One mobile layout bug found: switch-to-register button is positioned below the 844px viewport fold (top ~848px) making it inaccessible to a user scrolling on a standard mobile screen; the associated text 'New here? Create account' is visually truncated to 'New here? Cr...'.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout uses request.client.host which is the ingress proxy pod IP and rotates between multiple replicas (e.g. 10.64.129.166 and 10.64.130.9). As a result 5 wrong attempts get split across multiple login_attempts keys and the 429 lockout never fires. Fix: derive client IP from X-Forwarded-For header (first non-proxy entry) or X-Real-IP and fall back to request.client.host only if absent.

minor.issue: The `if False else (...)` ternary on line ~144 of server.py is dead code and should be simplified to just the timedelta(minutes=15) expression.

ui_bugs.issue: Switch-to-register link positioned below 844px viewport fold on mobile (absolute top ~848px at 390x844). The 'New here? Create account' row is only reachable by explicit scroll (or larger viewport). On narrow viewports the text visibly truncates to 'New here? Cr...'. mt-auto on that container pushes it below the minimum content height when the form + Google + Farcaster buttons are rendered.

The purple SIWF button shows only 'Sign in' (the @farcaster/auth-kit default label). Side-by-side with the 'Continue with Google' button it is visually ambiguous; label should be 'Sign In With Farcaster' or include a Farcaster/Warpcast icon + 'Continue with Farcaster'.

issues: Footer switch-to-register line is clipped below viewport; may cause new users to not find the register toggle.

action_items: Fix /api/auth/login brute-force key: read client IP from X-Forwarded-For (strip/split on ',' and take left-most) before falling back to request.client.host, otherwise the 429 lockout path is effectively dead code in the k8s preview/prod environment.
Adjust LoginPage layout so the 'switch-to-register' toggle stays within the first viewport on 390x844 (remove mt-auto, or move the toggle above the social buttons, or add visible scroll affordance).
Change the Farcaster auth-kit button label to 'Continue with Farcaster' for parity with the Google button.
Remove the `(...) if False else (...)` ternary in server.py login endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py login endpoint uses `if False else ...` dead-code ternary for locked_until — needs cleanup.

Brute-force lockout is single-node-only (see HIGH issue above). Consider also resetting count & locked_until only when NOT already locked (current code keeps pushing locked_until forward on every new failure regardless of prior state, so a well-timed attacker can never actually get locked because count never increments past 5 when split across pods, and simultaneously a legitimate user who hits 5 fails will have lock extended on each subsequent retry).
server.py relies on os.environ['MONGO_URL'] / os.environ['DB_NAME'] — good (no fallbacks). JWT_SECRET also required (good).
UserPublic omits `role` field; frontend can't detect admin users. If admin-only routes/UI are planned, expose role in /auth/me response.
auth.py set_auth_cookies hard-codes samesite='none' and secure=True — correct for HTTPS preview but will break local dev over HTTP. Consider env-driven cookie flags.
AuthContext.checkAuth swallows all errors silently and sets user=false; consider differentiating 401 (not authed) from network/server errors so the UI can show a retry state.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the auth flows actually testable (register, login, /me, logout, protected-route redirects, admin login). Google/Farcaster positive-path not testable without real third-party flow — only negative paths verified via backend.

test_credentials: admin@onlybase.app / admin123 — confirmed working. Test users created during runs are prefixed `test_` and can be cleaned with db.users.deleteMany({email: {$regex: '^test_'}}).
seed_data_creation: Multiple test_*@onlybase.app users were created during testing. login_attempts entries also created. Clear with: mongosh onlybase_db --eval 'db.login_attempts.deleteMany({}); db.users.deleteMany({email: {$regex: "^test_"}})'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend auth endpoints work end-to-end. Only real bug is the brute-force lockout key depends on request.client.host behind k8s ingress (rotates across pods). When retesting, verify fix by hitting /api/auth/login 5x with wrong pwd and expecting 429 on attempt 6. Frontend register/login/logout/profile/protected-routes all work. The switch-to-register toggle is below fold on standard mobile; test scripts must use scroll_into_view_if_needed() or JS click. Farcaster SIWF happy-path cannot be tested without Warpcast mobile — only endpoint negative-path (invalid sig -> 401) is covered.
rca of the issue: Brute-force lockout: `key = f"{request.client.host}:{email}"`. In Kubernetes, request.client.host is the sidecar/ingress IP, which load-balances across replicas (observed 10.64.129.166 and 10.64.130.9). Each pod lands on a different `key` row, so the $inc per-row never passes 5. Fix by using `request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for', '').split(',')[0].strip() or request.client.host`. Reproduction: 6 consecutive wrong logins all return 401 instead of the 6th returning 429.
